response.text: The period-check and closed-period queries returned results. The closed-period query was broad (every journal in a closed period, since 2024), so I'll tighten it to postings made after the period's close date, and check the duplicate-invoice pairs in detail.

arguments.sql:
SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO"
FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (324, 802, 690, 801) ORDER BY i."INV_ID"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD"
FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID"
WHERE p."STAT_CD" = 'C' AND p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"
